description: Redevelopment of the site to provide four buildings to deliver 168 residential dwellings (Class C3) and flexible retail floor space (247m2) of flexible A1/A3/A4: The works include the conversion and extension of Sumner House (Block A) from office use (Class B1-c) to provide 44 no flats and 4 no townhouses and partial demolition of a boundary wall; the erection of a part 4, part 6 storey block to provide 39 no flats on Sumner Avenue (Block B); a part four, part 6 storey building to provide 72 no. flats on Jocelyn Street (Block C); and a four storey block providing 9 flats on Melon Road (Block D), with 247m2 of flexible A1/A3/A4 use at ground floor level, together with car parking, hard and soft landscaping, and other associated works incidental to the development.
street_name: Open Land Rear Of 1-51 Peckham High Street Bounded By Sumner Avenue And Melon Road Open Land Adjacent To 59 Peckham High Street And Sumner House Located On Sumner Road
